notes.title: Returns
notes.content:
Oddly enough, it's not like we decided to communicate with you only in odd years. That's just how it all turned out... Our plans turned out to be a complete disaster. 2024 wasn't a very good year for The Detective. You could say it was terrible. We also entered the current year, 2025, with not the best prospects...

However, we are determined to complete the project. There have been some fundamental changes that - I hope - will allow us to resume and continue work on the project. Although, unfortunately, we are not sure whether we will be able to release the game this year.

The first resolution is to launch a news channel - here on Steam. We are not able to support social media - but we hope that here we will be able to provide recent information about the development of the project.

The first piece of information is the successful migration to [i]Godot [b]4.4[/b][/i]. The third attempt was successful - and took only 6 days (of which the actual time spent on the work can be summed up in a maximum of 2 days). Maybe this step was not necessary - but if it worked, it bodes well for the future.

For a start, maybe that's enough - I hope to post news about the project regularly (-ish).

Read you soon!

notes.title: Release delay
notes.content:
[h1]Hello.[/h1]

We think you deserve a few words of explanation. As you may have noticed, we have changed the game's release date to [b]2024[/b].

We are a small studio, creating the project in our free time. Life always verifies plans - no matter how cautious they may be. Work is progressing, but not as fast as we would like - and unfortunately there's not much we can do about it.

We want to finish the game and we will! However, we had to - we hope for the last time - move the date on which we will be successful to next year.

We hope that despite this, you will stay with us and that the joy of the game will reward you for waiting longer. We will try to update you more often about the progress from now on (please also visit our social media for more information).

[h3]See you on the murder mystery![/h3]
